subject: [hw] opus-dec2 -> DEC04/V40/IV: batching design for decode (beyond write-combining): bind the vdec_hal_* OAL imports to host code
body: facts/VDEC_REGISTERS.md section 4. Facts [V]: libvcodecdrv.so has no MMIO of its own; every VDEC register access is a cross-library PLT import from libvcodec_utility.so: vdec_hal_read_<m>(hw,core,reg), vdec_hal_write_<m>(hw,core,reg,val), vdec_hal_write_<m>_mask(hw,core,reg,mask,val) (~120 exports; util also calls its own exports through its PLT, e.g. init_fetch_done -> write_vld_ex). address = 0x16000000 + subblock(module, core 0 or 3=LAT, table in section 1) + 4*reg. Proposal (gain order): (1) DEC04 write-combining as done; add flush on every guest host-import call/syscall (usleep etc.). (2) Loader interposition of those imports: write -> queue RWVC_OP_WRITE, write_mask -> queue RWVC_OP_WRITE_MASK (kills ~40-60 RMW reads + their flushes per frame), read -> flush + RWVC_OP_READ, vdec_virt_hw_wfe_init_fetch_rdy/_process_flag/_all_dram_and_bits_proc -> RWVC_OP_POLL batch. Estimate ~25-40 ioctls/frame instead of ~400-650 (no combining) or ~70-130 (combining only), and no 25-40 guest insns per access. (3) HARD RULE: AVC_VLD 0x000-0x080, 0x23c, 0x240 (core 0x16022000, LAT 0x16012000) consume bits on every read: exactly one read per guest read, in order, never POLL/retry/verify them. IV/V40: if you want (2) I can write the import table (module -> slot -> subblock) as a patch for whoever owns the loader binding.
